entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Now. Have you played 'Facts or Fic..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now. Have you played 'Facts or Fiction' before?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. No need to explain the rules.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. No need to explain the rules."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have not, Duchess.""
entries.dialogueText: "I have not, Duchess."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sure, but could you go over the ru..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sure, but could you go over the rules again?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It's simple. You tell us three sta..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's simple. You tell us three statements about yourself. Two of them have to be true, and one must be a lie."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Great.""
entries.dialogueText: "Great."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gestured to Pabel, who quickly..."
entries.dialogueText: She gestured to Pabel, who quickly topped up her wine glass.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Each of us then guesses which stat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Each of us then guesses which statement is false. If we guess wrong, we have to drink."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It was just my turn. I'll let His..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was just my turn. I'll let His Majesty choose the next player."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I still find this childish. In my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still find this childish. In my day, if people wanted to get drunk, they got drunk."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""But if you insist.""
entries.dialogueText: "But if you insist."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She thought for a moment."
entries.dialogueText: She thought for a moment.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""And I once had to stop Queen Lyza..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I once had to stop Queen Lyza from purchasing a diamond necklace with Rizian treasury money."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""My late husband and I once underto..."
entries.dialogueText: "My late husband and I once undertook a three-week sailing trip to Galmland and back."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I have an antique coin collection..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have an antique coin collection that's worth more than my house."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There's no way your coin collectio..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's no way your coin collection is worth that much."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You didn't really sail to Galmland.""
entries.dialogueText: "You didn't really sail to Galmland."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My grandmother never would have tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "My grandmother never would have tried to embezzle from the treasury."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I agree. Lyza the Great was beyond..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. Lyza the Great was beyond those shenanigans."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I call foul on the Lyza story. Her..."
entries.dialogueText: "I call foul on the Lyza story. Her Majesty was beyond such shenanigans."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I can believe Her Majesty Queen Ly..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can believe Her Majesty Queen Lyza would attempt such a purchase. But not that you would stop it, Ms. Werner."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento grinned and shook his head..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento grinned and shook his head.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""This is too easy. If there's one t..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is too easy. If there's one thing you hated more than sailing, it was your dearly departed husband."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena sighed."
entries.dialogueText: Elena sighed.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Yes, that's right.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, that's right."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita and Pabel picked up their gl..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita and Pabel picked up their glasses. Each took a healthy sip.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up my glass and took a hea..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up my glass and took a healthy sip. Lucita and Pabel did the same.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up my glass and took a hea..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up my glass and took a healthy sip. Lucita did the same.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've got a fortune in antique co..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've got a fortune in antique coins, do you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So my grandmother wasn't such a sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "So my grandmother wasn't such a saint after all."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""To be fair, this was towards the e..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be fair, this was towards the end of her life. I think her mind was going."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Ask me anything about Markian duca..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ask me anything about Markian ducats and Rezenid medallions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ms. Werner, if you please.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ms. Werner, if you please."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Go ahead, Mr. Esquibel.""
entries.dialogueText: "Go ahead, Mr. Esquibel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's hear from Pabel.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's hear from Pabel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Since I missed your story, I think..."
entries.dialogueText: "Since I missed your story, I think you should take another turn, Duchess Azaro."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll give it a go myself, if you d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll give it a go myself, if you don't mind."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My councilors looked at each other..."
entries.dialogueText: My councilors looked at each other with no small amount of excitement.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could feel my head spinning. I ra..."
entries.dialogueText: I could feel my head spinning. I racked my brain for ideas.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I felt tired, but not drunk. I rack..."
entries.dialogueText: I felt tired, but not drunk. I racked my brain for ideas.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won the Porte Drazon Derby while..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won the Porte Drazon Derby while disguised as a commoner."
entries.menuText: [Lie] "I won the Porte Drazon Derby while disguised as a commoner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have a scar on my shoulder blade..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have a scar on my shoulder blade in the exact shape of the Pales Administrative District."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have a bullet wound on the back..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have a bullet wound on the back of my leg in the exact shape of the Pales Administrative District."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have a birthmark on my chest in..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have a birthmark on my chest in the exact shape of the Pales Administrative District."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was unfaithful to my wife.""
entries.dialogueText: "I was unfaithful to my wife."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was secretly happy when my fathe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was secretly happy when my father died."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Back when I was the Party Prince,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Back when I was the Party Prince, I got so intoxicated that I mistook a priceless Markian vase for a urinal."
entries.menuText: "Back when I was the Party Prince, I got so intoxicated that I mistook a priceless Markian vase for a urinal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have nightmares that I'll turn o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have nightmares that I'll turn out to be a failure like my father."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My great-grandfather King Xavi II..."
entries.dialogueText: "My great-grandfather King Xavi II never actually had a mustache. I drew one on his royal portrait a long time ago."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If I weren't king, I think I'd lik..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I weren't king, I think I'd like to be a farmer."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I never loved my wife.""
entries.dialogueText: "I never loved my wife."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can belch the Rizian national an..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can belch the Rizian national anthem."
entries.menuText: [Lie] "I can belch the Rizian national anthem."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The others exchanged troubled looks..."
entries.dialogueText: The others exchanged troubled looks. Laurento cautiously spoke up.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Growing up in Palas Toras, I once..."
entries.dialogueText: "Growing up in Palas Toras, I once mistook a priceless Markian vase for a urinal."
entries.menuText: "Growing up in Palas Toras, I once mistook a priceless Markian vase for a urinal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Princess Lena was my first kiss.""
entries.dialogueText: "Princess Lena was my first kiss."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sometimes I worry I'm *too* benevo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sometimes I worry I'm *too* benevolent."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My tablemates looked around at each..."
entries.dialogueText: My tablemates looked around at each other. Lucita was the first to speak up.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As you wish, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As you wish, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita gave me a sly smile."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita gave me a sly smile.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Despite my Azaro heritage, I could..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite my Azaro heritage, I couldn't stand the sight of blood as a child. There was a time when I fainted from pricking my own finger."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""My cousin Zola confided in me that..."
entries.dialogueText: "My cousin Zola confided in me that she despised her husband-to-be, so I falsified evidence that he was having an affair with a commoner. The engagement was broken off at once."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I accidentally shouted 'All Hail t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I accidentally shouted 'All Hail the New Queen!' at His Majesty King Valero's coronation."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""When I'm in a diplomatic meeting t..."
entries.dialogueText: "When I'm in a diplomatic meeting that I know is trivial, I draw caricatures instead of taking notes."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""When I was just out of university,..."
entries.dialogueText: "When I was just out of university, I challenged the mayor of Sallabes to a duel."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He paused to think."
entries.dialogueText: He paused to think.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And I have a 'lucky' set of underg..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I have a 'lucky' set of undergarments that I wear to important meetings and military exercises."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""His Majesty once had me weed a pat..."
entries.dialogueText: "His Majesty once had me weed a patch of stinging nettles for his amusement. Little did he know I rather enjoyed the sensation."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""With pleasure.""
entries.dialogueText: "With pleasure."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gave his wine glass a dramatic s..."
entries.dialogueText: He gave his wine glass a dramatic swirl.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're not really doodling during..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're not really doodling during meetings, are you?"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Certainly, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Certainly, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""My father once made me weed a patc..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father once made me weed a patch of stinging nettles as punishment for shirking off on duty. Little did he know I rather enjoyed the sensation."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Well done, Ms. Werner. Who's next?""
entries.dialogueText: "Well done, Ms. Werner. Who's next?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You despise aggression, Laurento...."
entries.dialogueText: "You despise aggression, Laurento. You wouldn't have instigated a duel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was at my father's coronation. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was at my father's coronation. I would have heard if anyone shouted 'queen'."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""He would if it was over a woman. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "He would if it was over a woman. I doubt he'd admit to drawing caricatures at meetings, no matter how unimportant."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""The duel scenario seems the most f..."
entries.dialogueText: "The duel scenario seems the most far-fetched to me."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Even if he were, I doubt he'd admi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if he were, I doubt he'd admit it to you."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It's more plausible than a council..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's more plausible than a councilor admitting to the King that he's been failing to take notes at meetings."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I've heard the duel story a hundre..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've heard the duel story a hundred times, Laurento. You didn't challenge the mayor of Sallabes. It was the Earl of Jales."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento gave her an abashed look."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento gave her an abashed look.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""You know me too well, Ms. Werner.""
entries.dialogueText: "You know me too well, Ms. Werner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What was the duel about?""
entries.dialogueText: "What was the duel about?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So you called my father a queen?""
entries.dialogueText: "So you called my father a queen?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This means you've been treating se..."
entries.dialogueText: "This means you've been treating serious diplomatic matters with frivolity, Mr. Esquibel."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The current-day Countess of Jales...."
entries.dialogueText: "The current-day Countess of Jales. Neither of us had the nerve to shoot, but he won the grand prize in the end."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Unimportant ones only, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unimportant ones only, Your Majesty. I assure you I take my position very seriously."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's a terrible habit and you will..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a terrible habit and you will stop it at once."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't mind as long as the job ge..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't mind as long as the job gets done."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita drained her glass as Elena,..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita drained her glass as Elena, Pabel and I watched.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Lucita drained her glass. I followe..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita drained her glass. I followed suit.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Lucita drained her glass. I followe..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita drained her glass. I followed suit.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita drained her glass. Elena wat..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita drained her glass. Elena watched with a triumphant smirk.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena smirked triumphantly. I noted..."
entries.dialogueText: Elena smirked triumphantly. I noted Pabel's look of slight concern.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento gave a sigh of relief. Luc..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento gave a sigh of relief. Lucita tapped the side of her glass for attention.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Quite accidentally, Your Majesty...."
entries.dialogueText: "Quite accidentally, Your Majesty. And it was drowned out in the loud chorus of other voices."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""How anticlimactic, Mr. Esquibel.""
entries.dialogueText: "How anticlimactic, Mr. Esquibel."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Who's our next victim?""
entries.dialogueText: "Who's our next victim?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She tapped on her glass. Pabel duti..."
entries.dialogueText: She tapped on her glass. Pabel dutifully refilled it.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Of course, Your Majesty. I will.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Your Majesty. I will."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a sudden feeling of tensi..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a sudden feeling of tension around the table. Lucita broke it with a tap on her glass.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked down at the table."
entries.dialogueText: He looked down at the table.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""In the '20s, I wrote a poem that w..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the '20s, I wrote a poem that was selected for the annual Rizian Literary Compendium. Pseudonymously, of course."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita laughed lightly."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita laughed lightly.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""There's the falsehood. Running a r..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's the falsehood. Running a royal household doesn't leave one with time for poetry."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""The butler's wine descriptions hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "The butler's wine descriptions have verged on poetry at times. I'd prefer to believe he doesn't take perverse pleasure in stinging nettles."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""And *I'd* rather not believe the s..."
entries.dialogueText: "And *I'd* rather not believe the story about the Rumburgian valet. As hilarious as it might have been."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, the pepper story has got to b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, the pepper story has got to be the lie. Pabel is too professional for such tomfoolery."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would know if Pabel had written..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would know if Pabel had written poetry."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pabel's a great butler, but he's n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pabel's a great butler, but he's no poet."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't like stinging nettles, P..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't like stinging nettles, Pabel. No one does."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel smiled grimly."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel smiled grimly.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Correct. That was the worst pain I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Correct. That was the worst pain I've ever felt in my life."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Actually, the poetry part is true.""
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, the poetry part is true."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""And weeding that nettle patch was..."
entries.dialogueText: "And weeding that nettle patch was the worst pain I've ever felt in my life."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Actually, that isn't a lie. The po..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, that isn't a lie. The poor man was sneezing for the rest of the night."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry about that. I was a horr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry about that. I was a horrible kid."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My butler seemed reluctant to speak..."
entries.dialogueText: My butler seemed reluctant to speak. He gave a graceful nod.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My butler gave a graceful nod."
entries.dialogueText: My butler gave a graceful nod.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I once overheard a Rumburgian roya..."
entries.dialogueText: "I once overheard a Rumburgian royal valet make a demeaning comment about Queen Mother Estela during a diplomatic visit. I persuaded our chef to put an excessive amount of pepper in his food at the staff dinner."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel shifted in his seat."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel shifted in his seat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel shifted in his seat."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel shifted in his seat.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It served you right. I remember yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It served you right. I remember you had given me an odd look earlier in the day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wait. I want to know more about th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wait. I want to know more about this poem."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You played a dangerous game with R..."
entries.dialogueText: "You played a dangerous game with Rumburg. What if he'd found out and told Beatrice?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How brutal of your father.""
entries.dialogueText: "How brutal of your father."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel shrugged."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel shrugged.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""He was worried I was distracting y..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was worried I was distracting you from your princely duties."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel shrugged."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel shrugged.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""It was long ago, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "It was long ago, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""It worked. I always did my chores..."
entries.dialogueText: "It worked. I always did my chores after that."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""He wouldn't have. I told him that..."
entries.dialogueText: "He wouldn't have. I told him that in Rizia, pepper was a luxury reserved for only the most honored guests."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""There's not much to know, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's not much to know, Your Majesty. It was many years ago."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita cleared her throat."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita cleared her throat.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I think we're forgetting something.""
entries.dialogueText: "I think we're forgetting something."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Lucita, Laurento and I drank from o..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita, Laurento and I drank from our glasses. My foreign councilor had a contemplative look as he put his down.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She turned to Laurento, and the two..."
entries.dialogueText: She turned to Laurento, and the two clinked glasses and drank. My foreign councilor had a contemplative look as he put his glass down.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I read that compendium regularly...."
entries.dialogueText: "I read that compendium regularly. What was your pseudonym?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Wait, let me guess...""
entries.dialogueText: "Wait, let me guess..."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Aha! 'Paul Adair'! From 1929!""
entries.dialogueText: "Aha! 'Paul Adair'! From 1929!"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I was the shadow to your light..."
entries.dialogueText:
"I was the shadow to your light

A silent witness to the burden you bore.

A chasm yawns between us now,

Eager to be filled with talk, with touch."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Like two rising tides beneath a se..."
